paragraphs: R' Yitzchak bar Marta, Pesachim 33b. Shmuel bar Marta, or R' Shmuel, Berakhot 25b, Pesachim 113b.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The colon markers, sometimes followed by periods, give 121b/33b/25b/113b conventionally; none is newly verified. Earlier יצתק and omitted 25b are machine differences, not adopted source forms.

Berakhot and 25b join across the line break. This is a collection of patronymic attestations; catalog all-sages scope does not prove exhaustive coverage or one father. The explicit or between untitled Shmuel bar Marta and R' Shmuel remains; both abbreviated personal titles stay R'. Abba is explicit.
